messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — our arm64 Alpine base (r-base:alpine-3.18-arm64) pulls openssl with CVE-2026-XXXX flagged by Snyk.

mike: where's the CVSS? is it remote code exec or just info leak?

anna: CVSS 7.2, remote crypto padding issue. upstream patch available in openssl 3.0.11. Alpine has a backport in 3.18.2 but arm64 manifests haven't been rebuilt yet.

raj: can we just pin to the patched apk package? `apk add --no-cache openssl=3.0.11-r1` ?

sarah: careful — pinning exact package breaks cache layer reuse across variants. we should rebuild base images with updated package and push tags, not ad-hoc pins in app images.

mike: plan proposal:
- build new arm64 base images for alpine-3.18 with openssl 3.0.11
- push to registry with `alpine-3.18-openssl-3.0.11-arm64` tag
- run canary deploys for internal infra services that use this base
- coordinate with customer-facing infra teams for uptime windows

anna: +1. add test matrix: smoke (start containers), tls-handshake test (openssl s_client), and a quick fuzz of reconnects. also scan with trivy and internal SBOM comparison.

raj: CI changes:
- bump base image reference in buildkite job: `env BASE_IMAGE=redwood/base:alpine-3.18-openssl-3.0.11-arm64`
- add `--platform linux/arm64` to buildx build to force arm64
- invalidate cache by touching `base/Dockerfile` so package layer rebuilds

build-bot: CI job triggered: `base-image-rebuild-arm64-1789994123` started

mike: rollout strategy: canary 5% for 24h -> 25% for 24h -> full. rollback on TLS errors or SLO regressions.

sarah: checklist for release:
- [ ] update infra docs + tag mapping
- [ ] KMS rotation unaffected
- [ ] create postmortem template (if rollback)
- [ ] security signoff

anna: who owns the final push? @mike? also need to coordinate with registry retention — we'll keep old tags for 7 days.

mike: I'll own push and canary orchestration.

raj: one extra note: musl vs glibc behavior — some apps rely on openssl provider quirks. add a short compatibility test: do RSA sign/verify and libcrypto symbol loads.

anna: agreed. add to smoke:
```
# TLS handshake test
openssl s_server -accept 8443 -cert test.pem -key test.key &
sleep 1
openssl s_client -connect localhost:8443 -msg
```

build-bot: CI job finished: SUCCESS, image pushed `registry.redwood/base:alpine-3.18-openssl-3.0.11-arm64`

sarah: schedule canary start at 03:00 UTC to minimize blast radius.

mike: canary started 03:00 UTC. will post metrics link in #eng-sre.

anna: thanks team. I'll open a short changelog entry and ping product teams.

sarah: :thumbsup:
